sections.heading: Introduction and references
body: This draft lists requested items with report citations and attached scopes for attorney and agent review before sending.

fields: Contingency deadline as advised by counsel:

sections.heading: Numbered requests
body: One numbered item per row or grouped scope with location, report citation, requested action, standard, and verification access.

sections.heading: Closing and logistics
body: State response logistics and verification access. Keep language factual.

fields: Delivery method as directed by counsel:

sections.heading: Exposure and options
body: Record totals, leanings with reasons, lender constraints, timeline feasibility, and attorney flags.

sections.heading: Chosen path
body: Record the chosen path in plain words with owners and next actions. This form is a thinking record, not a legal instrument.

sections.heading: What to send the contractor
body: Send report pages, photos, and access details, and ask for a written scope with inclusions, exclusions, price, and validity dates.

sections.heading: What to record on return
body: Record low and high figures, source, date, inclusions, and exclusions into the deficiency log.
